def select_cheapest(parcels):
    """One entry per parcel, in input order. Ties on cost keep the first service in SERVICES."""
    result = []

cat >> tests/test_shipping.py <<'EOF'


def test_price_ignores_dimensions():
    from shipping import select_cheapest
    bulky = {"id": "A", "weight_kg": "2", "length_cm": "50", "width_cm": "40", "height_cm": "40", "zone": "urban"}
    compact = dict(bulky, id="B", length_cm="10", width_cm="10", height_cm="10")
    assert quotes(bulky) == quotes(compact)
    a, b = select_cheapest([bulky, compact])
    assert a["cost"] == b["cost"] == 6.0


def test_select_cheapest_batch():
    from shipping import select_cheapest
    out = select_cheapest(load())
    assert [o["id"] for o in out] == ["P1", "P2", "P3"]
    assert out[0] == {"id": "P1", "status": "selected", "service": "Express", "days": 2, "cost": 6.0}
    assert out[1]["service"] == "Express" and out[1]["cost"] == 5.5
    assert out[2]["status"] == "unavailable" and out[2]["reason"]
EOF
